reviews.title: Unable to Send 60-Second Compressed Videos Despite Premium Subscription
reviews.text:
I subscribed to the Premium version mainly for the 60-second status feature. Unfortunately, after the latest update, this feature no longer works.

Whenever I compress a video into a single 60-second status, it fails to send to WhatsApp. The app repeatedly asks me to reactivate WhatsApp, even though WhatsApp is already active and functioning normally. The only workaround is to split the video into 30-second segments, which defeats the purpose of paying for the Premium feature.

This issue did not exist before the update. One of the key Premium benefits has effectively become unusable, making the subscription feel less valuable.

Please fix this issue as soon as possible.
